# AgentTrace Gateway (v2.0.0)

> A small Rust reverse proxy for local AI agent setups: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that scrubs secrets from every message before forwarding or logging, routes to local Ollama / LAN worker models, records everything in a signed SHA-256 hash-chained SQLite ledger, and exposes a 17-tool MCP server.

## What it does
- `POST /v1/chat/completions` and `GET /v1/models`: OpenAI-compatible proxy with DLP redaction (modes: redact, block, off) and routing by model name.
- Signed ledger: SHA-256 chain plus Ed25519 node signatures; verify with `GET /api/v1/ledger/verify`.
- MCP server (`src/bin/agent_trace_mcp.rs`, stdio JSON-RPC; also `POST /api/v1/mcp`) with 17 tools: record_project_decision, dispatch_cluster_prompt, verify_ledger, query_telemetry, inspect_cluster, flag_incident, explain_route, decide_route, set_route_override, list_route_overrides, remove_route_override, analyze_telemetry, get_delegation_config, set_delegation_config, get_telemetry_handoff, get_security_alerts, acknowledge_alert.
- UI: `/console` (terminal-style event stream) and `/dashboard`. `GET /api/v1/savings` reports tokens served locally.

## Security model
Binds 127.0.0.1 by default, no CORS, Host header check (421) when loopback-bound, optional `AGENTTRACE_TOKEN` required on every route except static pages and `/login`, and `--insecure-lan` refuses to start without a token.

## Key source files
- [src/proxy.rs](src/proxy.rs): chat proxy and request scrubbing
- [src/dlp.rs](src/dlp.rs): secret and prompt-injection scanner
- [src/handlers.rs](src/handlers.rs): router, auth and Host middleware
- [src/secrets.rs](src/secrets.rs): token auth and upstream allowlist
- [src/router.rs](src/router.rs), [src/registry.rs](src/registry.rs), [src/delegation_engine/](src/delegation_engine/): model routing
- [src/ledger.rs](src/ledger.rs), [src/ledger_writer.rs](src/ledger_writer.rs), [src/db/](src/db/): signed ledger and SQLite store
- [src/agent_interface/](src/agent_interface/): MCP tools and schemas
